claim: Holds a Singpass account and is 15 or older, per Singpass's own is_u15_user flag.

privacy.summary: Only Singpass's yes/no 'under 15' flag and the request status are revealed. Your NRIC/FIN, mobile, email and everything else in the response stay hidden.
guarantees: The flag is bound to a real TLS session with portal.singpass.gov.sg (MPC-TLS), so it can't be edited.
All other bytes of the response are redacted before the verifier sees them.
limits: Only proves 15 or older; Singpass exposes no other age threshold here.
No uniqueness: the same person can earn this badge on any number of holders.
trust: The browser extension and the site code you load.
Singpass's response is what the badge is based on; Singpass isn't involved and doesn't endorse it.

changelog: First release: reveals Singpass's is_u15_user flag; no commitments or circuit.

prove_params.notes: Profile endpoint behind Singpass's 'Manage your Singpass account' step-up login. Only status and result.is_u15_user are revealed; the verifier checks status == SUCCESS and is_u15_user == false. singpass_id, mobile_number, email and everything else stay hidden. No commitments, no circuit.
